title: Quicklaunch cheat-sheet cards and compact screenshots for Optimize Toolkit
creator: Emily Park
description: Create a concise set of cheat-sheet cards, compact product screenshots, and annotated visuals to support first-run onboarding for the Optimize Toolkit (batching, KV/prefix caching recommendations, and quantization UI). The goal is to give ML engineers and product-first developers a 30-60 second understanding of recommended controls and the expected cost/latency tradeoffs, plus a minimal set of screenshot assets for the docs and release notes.
deliverables: Figma file with 6 cheat-card variants (desktop + mobile)
Annotated screenshots for: First-run recommendations, Manual tuning panel, Quantization presets modal
Export-ready PNGs (3 sizes) and SVGs for console docs
Copy deck with microcopy strings for each card and tooltip
Component spec (CSS tokens, spacing, states) for handoff
QA checklist and accessibility report (contrast + keyboard nav)
acceptance_criteria: Three core flows covered: First-run recommendations, Manual tuning, Advanced quant profiles
All images exported at 1600x900, 1200x675, and 480x270 with descriptive filenames
Microcopy signed off by PM and Technical Writer
Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for primary text; keyboard focus states implemented in component spec
Design tokens and spacing align with console-2025.12 theme
Assets uploaded to the Optimize Toolkit docs folder and linked in PR description
design_notes: Keep language concise and non-prescriptive: show recommended ranges (e.g. batch size 8-64) rather than hard requirements. Use three visual tiers for recommendations: Performance (green), Balanced (amber), Cost-saving (blue). For quantization UI, surface 3 presets (FP16, INT8, INT4) with a short caption showing typical throughput and expected percent change in token cost. Include an inline tooltip pattern for 'KV cache hit rate' with a sample animation showing prefix reuse. Avoid deep technical jargon on first-run cards; provide a 'learn more' link to advanced docs.
